HYSTERESIS.title: Hysteresis
HYSTERESIS.description: If a card with [gold]Hysteresis[/gold] enters your Discard Pile by being played, it returns to your Hand and loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Hysteresis[/gold].
HYSTERESIS.smartDescription: The next [blue]{Hysteresis}[/blue] {Hysteresis:plural:time|times} it enters your Discard Pile by being played, return it to your Hand.
HASTE.title: Haste
HASTE.description: After a card with [gold]Haste[/gold] is played, draw [blue]{HasteDrawingAmount}[/blue] {HasteDrawingAmount:plural:card|cards} and lose [gold]Haste[/gold]. The drawn cards gain [blue]the stacks lost - 1[/blue] [gold]Haste[/gold].
HASTE.smartDescription: After being played, draw [blue]{HasteDrawingAmount}[/blue] {HasteDrawingAmount:plural:card|cards} and lose [gold]Haste[/gold]. The drawn cards gain [blue]{HastePassingAmount}[/blue] [gold]Haste[/gold].
